fusions.name: Finger's Breadth
fusions.desc: A placed jab that deals 8 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds up to 3 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Unshaking Aim
fusions.desc: Strikes a target up to 7 tiles away for 30 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Neat Sutures
fusions.desc: Sews your wounds shut, restoring 16 health to you, 8% more for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%), with a 10% chance to heal critically.

fusions.name: Never a Tremor
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 10%.
